objective: Reduce the manual effort needed to create an independently reviewed slope gate without allowing assistant output to become human truth.

properties: Binds every frame to its source-image SHA-256 and the input result packet hashes.
Provides raw images, review overlays, a contact sheet, a static HTML index, a manifest, and a file receipt.
Every row is candidate_only=true, human_truth=false, approved_for_training=false, and training_return_allowed=false.
The static page cannot sign decisions; final review must use the LabelAgent human-review gate.

visual_readback.positive_proxy_cards: Eight orange cards show the legacy auto target boundary and machine output with an explicit NOT HUMAN TRUTH banner.
visual_readback.negative_cards: Twenty-four blue cards show indoor floor, pallets and obstacle scenes with HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED banners.

publication_boundary: Raw and review images remain in untracked local artifacts and are not uploaded to GitHub or CNB. Code and non-image evidence may be synchronized separately.
remaining_gate: A human must inspect/correct each selected frame and submit through the workbench review gate before these samples can support accuracy or training claims.
